QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_20

question.text: If a Cat III AIF's NAV has only decreased since inception, the High-Water Mark is taken as:

answer.text: Initial subscription price of units issued by the fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 6.1.3 specifies the fallback HWM = initial subscription price when NAV has only decreased since inception. The Trap: Zero/prior NAV/called capital are not the HWM fallback. Cross-Exam Context: Ensures investors are protected during drawdown phases. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Confirm the fallback mechanism is clearly drafted in the PPM to avoid disputes later.
